Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the business and occupation taxation of health care services provided to government.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to business and occupation taxation of health careservices provided to government; and adding a new section to chapter82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) This chapter does not apply to amounts received by a healthcare provider from the United States or any instrumentality of theUnited States, or from the state of Washington or any municipalcorporation or political subdivision of the state of Washington, to thesame extent provided for health or social welfare organizations underRCW 82.04.4297. (2) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Health professional" means a health care practitioner who islicensed by the state of Washington under chapters 18.57, 18.57A,18.71, and 18.71A RCW. (b) "Health care provider" means any health professional, hospital, p. 1 SB 5922or other institution, organization, or person that furnishes any healthcare services and is licensed or otherwise authorized to furnish suchservices.
